onboarding.tour.welcome.title: Welcome to SpeakSpace Local
onboarding.tour.welcome.desc: SpeakSpace Local records, transcribes, organises and searches on your own computer without uploading audio. The sidebar opens the studio, dashboard, workspaces, model management and settings; this shorter tour covers the areas you will use most.
onboarding.tour.nav.title: Everything starts from this column
onboarding.tour.nav.desc: Click an item to go there. The studio at the top is the one you will use daily; below it are the dashboard, your notes, models and settings.
onboarding.tour.composer.title: Type, record or upload from one place
onboarding.tour.composer.desc: Ask in the text box, start a live recording, or upload existing audio with the buttons on the left. Turn on agent search when AI should find relevant context across your library. Audio transcription still stays on this device.
onboarding.tour.composer.hint: Type # to choose specific notes; agent search is useful across older notes, but takes a little longer
onboarding.tour.record.title: This button starts recording
onboarding.tour.record.desc: Click once to start, click again to stop. Speech becomes text locally, appearing as you speak — no waiting.
onboarding.tour.record.hint: While recording the button shows a live waveform, so you know the mic is on
onboarding.tour.upload.title: Already have an audio file? Upload it here
onboarding.tour.upload.desc: Meeting recordings, voice memos, downloaded audio — pick a file with this button and it goes through exactly the same transcription pipeline as live recording.
onboarding.tour.agent.title: Let it search your notes by itself
onboarding.tour.agent.desc: Normally it only reads what you hand it. With this on, it searches your whole library, decides which notes to read, and then answers.
onboarding.tour.agent.hint: Great when a question spans several older notes — the tradeoff is it takes longer
onboarding.tour.library.title: This column is your note library
onboarding.tour.library.desc: Every saved note lives here, grouped by workspace. When a recording ends you pick a workspace to save it into, and the note shows up in that group.
onboarding.tour.libraryDrag.title: Choose conversation context from the library
onboarding.tour.libraryDrag.desc: Notes are grouped by workspace. Drag a note into the chat to attach it, or double-click it to open the summary and full transcript while you ask questions.
onboarding.tour.libraryDrag.hint: You can also drag a workspace name to attach every note inside it
onboarding.tour.notePreview.title: Double-click a note to read it
onboarding.tour.notePreview.desc: Double-click a note card and its details slide out on the right: the AI summary and the full transcript, so you can read the source while you ask. Close it with the cross in its corner and the chat goes back to full width.
onboarding.tour.notePreview.hint: A single click only selects — it takes two to open
onboarding.tour.recents.title: Notes and recent conversations share this column
onboarding.tour.recents.desc: Every exchange is saved automatically, so opening a recent conversation restores its context. Drag the divider above to give the note library or conversation history more room.
onboarding.tour.splitter.title: This divider is draggable
onboarding.tour.splitter.desc: Notes above, recent conversations below. Drag this line up or down to change how much room each one gets.
onboarding.tour.splitter.hint: Your chosen split is saved for the next time you open the app
onboarding.tour.workspace.title: Create a workspace for each project
onboarding.tour.workspace.desc: Enter a name above to create a workspace; existing workspaces appear below and open from their cards. Keep each project, class or client’s recordings and manual notes together.
onboarding.tour.workspaceDetail.title: Manage the workspace from the top bar
onboarding.tour.workspaceDetail.desc: From here you can return to the list, rename the workspace or move it to Trash. Text and semantic search help you find content quickly.
onboarding.tour.workspaceDetail.hint: When a workspace exists, the tour opens the most recent one automatically; otherwise it skips the detail steps
onboarding.tour.workspaceNotes.title: Organise and use notes in batches here
onboarding.tour.workspaceNotes.desc: Select notes—or select them all in one click—to start an AI conversation with several notes or move them to Trash together. The button below also creates a manual note.
onboarding.tour.workspaceNotes.hint: An empty workspace is fine: create the first note, then search, select and batch-process it
onboarding.tour.newNote.title: You can also write a note by hand
onboarding.tour.newNote.desc: Not everything comes from audio. Create one here and type it yourself — it is searchable and gets todos extracted just like a transcribed note.
onboarding.tour.dashboard.title: The dashboard combines your overview and note shortcut
onboarding.tour.dashboard.desc: See total notes, pinned notes, transcribed words and open to-dos at a glance. Select a metric card to filter the list, or use New Note at the top to start a manual note or recording.
onboarding.tour.calendar.title: Todos are pulled out of your conversations
onboarding.tour.calendar.desc: After each transcription the local language model reads the whole text and picks out lines like "who needs to do what, by when", then writes them into this calendar with their dates. A dot means that day has something: one orange dot per day, plus a blue one when there is more than one item.
onboarding.tour.calendar.hint: Click a date to see that day, and tick items off when done
onboarding.tour.models.title: The AI runs on your own machine
onboarding.tour.models.desc: Speech recognition, speech synthesis, semantic search and the language model each need a model downloaded. Each one has a small dot next to its name: green means that capability is ready, grey means it is not installed and the matching feature simply will not work.
onboarding.tour.models.hint: Install speech recognition first — recording cannot become text without it. Unsure which one? Pick the one tagged as recommended
onboarding.tour.settings.title: Preferences and device setup live in Settings
onboarding.tour.settings.desc: Use the categories on the left for appearance, language, assistant behaviour, background controls, hardware recommendations and Trash. Automatic read-aloud lives here, and you can replay this tour at any time.
onboarding.tour.settingsAgent.title: Assistant behaviour is tuned here
onboarding.tour.settingsAgent.desc: The Assistant category holds the read-aloud switch: leave it on and the assistant speaks each answer as it finishes, which is handy when your hands are busy. Turn it off if you would rather press the play button yourself.
onboarding.tour.settingsAgent.hint: Reading aloud needs a TTS model installed in Model Management first
onboarding.tour.calendarTodos.title: Calendar, to-dos and notes stay linked both ways
onboarding.tour.calendarTodos.desc: The local model extracts dated to-dos from transcripts and marks them on the calendar. Hover a dotted day to inspect its tasks and reveal the source note; hover a to-do date in a note and the matching calendar day lights up.
onboarding.tour.calendarTodos.hint: The demo runs automatically; you can also click a date to review its tasks and mark them complete
onboarding.tour.todoDateHover.title: It works the other way round too
onboarding.tour.todoDateHover.desc: Hover any date in this column and the matching days flash in the calendar. A note with several dates flashes all of them; dates in another month light up the month arrows instead.
onboarding.tour.todoDateHover.hint: This one runs by itself too — watch which days light up on the left
onboarding.tour.background.title: Set background behaviour and global shortcuts together
onboarding.tour.background.desc: Choose whether closing the window quits or minimises to the system tray. While SpeakSpace Local stays in the background, the three shortcuts below can show stats, show to-dos or start a quick recording from any app, and every combination is editable.
onboarding.tour.background.hint: To quit completely, right-click the SpeakSpace Local tray icon and choose Quit
onboarding.tour.shortcuts.title: Three global shortcuts, from anywhere
onboarding.tour.shortcuts.desc: Ctrl+Alt+D for the figures, Ctrl+Alt+T for to-dos, Ctrl+Alt+R to start recording — all work without bringing SpeakSpace Local to the front. Each is editable: click the box and press your combination; Esc cancels, Backspace unbinds, and a combination already taken by another app is flagged on the spot.
onboarding.tour.shortcuts.hint: A combination needs at least one Ctrl / Alt / Shift
onboarding.tour.hudStats.title: Three quick actions without switching windows
onboarding.tour.hudStats.desc: Ctrl+Alt+D shows your stats, Ctrl+Alt+T shows today and tomorrow’s to-dos, and Ctrl+Alt+R starts a quick recording. This step demonstrates the stats HUD; all three appear briefly above whatever you are working on.
onboarding.tour.hudStats.hint: Hover a HUD to pause auto-close; edit any shortcut on the previous screen
onboarding.tour.hudTodos.title: Ctrl+Alt+T: today and tomorrow
onboarding.tour.hudTodos.desc: Same corner, but only today and tomorrow — overdue and next week stay out of the way. The tick on the left marks an item done, the pin on the right moves it to the top, and the title opens the main window.
onboarding.tour.hudTodos.hint: Ticking one clears it without opening the app
onboarding.tour.hudTodos.sampleA: Send the sync notes to the team
onboarding.tour.hudRecord.title: Ctrl+Alt+R: capture a thought
onboarding.tour.hudRecord.desc: Whatever you are working in, one press starts recording and a small capsule appears at the bottom centre. Press the tick and the main window opens and runs the usual transcribe-review-save flow; press the cross and the take is discarded.
onboarding.tour.hudRecord.hint: Pressing Ctrl+Alt+R again is the same as the tick
onboarding.tour.trash.title: Deleted things can come back
onboarding.tour.trash.desc: Notes, conversations and whole workspaces go to Trash rather than disappearing. Filter by type, search by name, see when each was removed, restore in one click — or delete permanently once you are sure. Only that last step is irreversible.
onboarding.tour.trash.hint: Right after deleting, the undo toast is quicker
onboarding.tour.done.title: That is it — go try it
onboarding.tour.done.desc: If you have not installed a model yet, start with speech recognition in Model Management. Without it a recording is only saved as audio, never turned into text.
